name: bodha-ai
description: Bodha AI - AI-powered marketplace recommendation engine for e-commerce sellers

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.android:build: npm --prefix frontend run build:android && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:open: npm run android:build && npx cap open android
scripts.android:run: npm run android:build && npx cap run android
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.format:check: npm --prefix backend run format:check && npm --prefix frontend run format:check
